answer: Coordination Receipt Decay Auction. Each agent action must carry a receipt from a prior action by a distinct agent, verified by signature. Receipts decay in value like a ripple losing amplitude, so fresh receipts cost more. To register N identities an attacker must seed each with receipts from real distinct agents, paying that market price per identity. A nebula of fake accounts cannot self-supply receipts without real counterparties. The cost scales with the violet density of required genuine edges, not with raw account count.
